test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the parts to form a correct sentence:

(1) The athlete trained relentlessly.

(2) He overcame several injuries.

(3) He qualified for the finals.

(4) He inspired young players.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To form a meaningful and coherent sentence, the correct sequence is **1-2-3-4**.
 
• The athlete trained relentlessly (1), which logically leads to overcoming several injuries (2).
 
• After overcoming injuries, he qualified for the finals (3), and finally, he inspired young players (4).
 
• This arrangement ensures a chronological and logical progression of events.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The athlete trained relentlessly. He overcame several injuries. He qualified for the finals. He inspired young players."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (2-1-3-4):** This sequence disrupts the logical order by starting with overcoming injuries before the athlete's training effort.
 
• **Option 3 (1-2-4-3):** Placing "He inspired young players" before "He qualified for the finals" breaks the logical progression.
 
• **Option 4 (1-3-2-4):** This sequence misplaces "He qualified for the finals" before overcoming injuries, which does not make sense chronologically.
